selection_reason: Contains all three Train cases failed in both no-skill repeats, three near-boundary success guards, and all six ALFWorld task families. The subset is diagnostic, not independent generalization evidence.
train_gate: Proceed to one full official Val only if H005 scores at least 12/14, has no execution/zero-response/terminal model error, and does not regress more than one case passed in both no-skill Train repeats.
val_gate: Strictly exceed the clean no-skill 16/18 Val baseline; 17/18 is provisional because one case can be natural variation.
test_policy: Run official Test once only after Best is frozen. Do not use Test cases or outcomes to generate/edit/select a Skill.
adoption_gate: At least 5 of 14 official Train cases must invoke the bundled safe_send.py helper; a score without helper adoption is treated as model variation.
candidate_type: Standard SKILL.md plus optional Skill-side script; fixed Pi and official bridge/scorer are unchanged.
controlled_factor: H004 and H005 have identical Skill body and helper script; only frontmatter description differs.
